FN-ICUB666-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 301
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/23/2024
Senate Bill 301 as introduced would increase the benefit expenses of the Teacher's Retirement
System (TRS) by an estimated $75.3 million for Fiscal Year 2025, and declining by an
estimated 3% each fiscal year thereafter, to provide a 3% cost-of-living-adjustment (COLA), of
not less than $15 per month, for certain retirees or beneficiaries of TRS. Pursuant to this bill,
this COLA would be contingent on the cost of the COLA being included and appropriated in the
Education Trust Fund act each fiscal year by a separate employer rate, pursuant to HB 201 of the
Regular Session 2024, which is estimated to be a 0.9% additional employer rate for Fiscal Year
2025 and declining by an estimated 5.1% each fiscal year thereafter.
